=== cisco / none
! No break-glass local user is recorded for scope 'lab': with the server
! unreachable and no local account on the device, nobody can log in. Record one with
!   tacctl scope breakglass lab add <name> [--role admin|operator|readonly]

=== wti / none
        No break-glass local user is recorded for scope 'lab': with the server
        unreachable and no local account on the device, nobody can log in. Record one with
          tacctl scope breakglass lab add <name> [--role admin|operator|readonly]
=== unfilled / none

=== cisco / one admin
! --- Break-glass local users (scope: lab) ---
! The 'local' method of 'aaa authentication login' above admits these only when no
! server answers.
! tacctl stores no credential: replace <TYPE9-HASH> with the type 9 hash ($9$...) of a password
! you keep (the hash, not the password: 'secret 9' takes a hash as it appears in 'show running-config'),
! then remove the '! '.
! username lab-admin privilege 15 secret 9 <TYPE9-HASH>
=== cisco legacy / one admin
! --- Break-glass local users (scope: lab) ---
! The 'local' method of 'aaa authentication login' above admits these only when no
! server answers.
! tacctl stores no credential: replace <HASH> with the type 5 hash ($1$...) of a password you keep,
! then remove the '! '. (IOS 12.x has no type 9.)
! username lab-admin privilege 15 secret 5 <HASH>
=== juniper / one admin
# Break-glass local users (scope: lab):
# the authentication-order above names the server only, so Junos falls back to these local
# accounts only when no server answers.
# tacctl stores no credential: replace <HASH> with your own crypt hash ($6$...),
# remove the '# ' before the commit of Step 8.
# set system login user lab-admin class RW-CLASS authentication encrypted-password '<HASH>'
=== wti / one admin
        Local accounts let someone in when the server is unreachable (Fallback Local, Step 3).
        tacctl stores no password: on the serial session of Step 1 add each account to the unit's
        user directory (/H lists its command) with the access level shown, and set a password you keep:
          lab-admin  Access Level: Administrator  Password: <PASSWORD>
        Save as in Step 7.
=== unfilled / one admin
Unfilled break-glass credentials (tacctl stores none; put in your own): lab-admin (admin)

=== cisco / local-first
! --- Break-glass local users (scope: lab) ---
! The scope's aaa-order is local-first: the 'local' method of 'aaa authentication login'
! above tries these accounts before the server.
! tacctl stores no credential: replace <TYPE9-HASH> with the type 9 hash ($9$...) of a password
! you keep (the hash, not the password: 'secret 9' takes a hash as it appears in 'show running-config'),
! then remove the '! '.
! username lab-admin privilege 15 secret 9 <TYPE9-HASH>
=== juniper / local-first
# Break-glass local users (scope: lab):
